updates.note: Management reaffirmed the dark store guidance for March.
updates.quote: On store addition, we're on track on our guidance for March of 3,000 stores. We remain firmly on track.

new_promises.statement: Expect quick commerce to deliver 60% CAGR over the next three years.
new_promises.quote: We've given overall guidance of 60% CAGR and that would obviously mean some reasonable store expansion
new_promises.speaker: Akshant Goyal

new_promises.statement: Targeting around 3-3.5% implied EBITDA margin for quick commerce in the next three to four years.
new_promises.quote: the implied margin for quick commerce comes to around, say, roughly 3-3.5%, give or take. Is that the number which we are expecting from a margin perspective in the next three to four years? ... broadly in line with how we're thinking about it.
new_promises.speaker: Akshant Goyal
